scope: Deterministic weighted RandomConfig selection. The client PRNG remains explicitly unknown; the sandbox RNG is the frozen deterministic MT19937 abstraction with clone/snapshot/hash.

evidence.support: frozen SandboxRng: PYTHON_RANDOM_MT19937, 64-bit draws, state export/import, client algorithm UNKNOWN.
five RandomConfig instances use odds lists of two or three fixed values whose sums are exactly 1.0 within the serialized precision.

selected_model.draw: one uniform [0,1) draw per RandomConfig evaluation; the draw is recorded in the deterministic trace.
selected_model.normalization: odds are normalized by their sum before selection, preserving non-unit serialized totals exactly.
selected_model.selection: the selected index is the first index whose cumulative normalized odds exceeds the draw; the last index covers draw==1 only through the [0,1] boundary rule.
selected_model.ordering: RNG consumption happens at the operation boundary in source order; clone/snapshot/hash include the full RNG state.
selected_model.client_algorithm: UNKNOWN; this packet does not claim client PRNG reproduction.
